## Packages (15 on pub.dev)

### On-Device AI
- **ai_core_codespark** — Core embedding engine with offline MiniLM model for semantic understanding
- **semantic_search_codespark** — Query-driven semantic search with debounced input and MMR diversity ranking
- **smart_suggestions_codespark** — Anchor-based recommendations with MMR diverse ranking and centroid matching

### Text & UI
- **text_comparison_score_codespark** — String similarity using Levenshtein, Damerau-Levenshtein, and Jaro-Winkler algorithms
- **text_highlight_codespark** — Text highlighting with single, multiple, and regex query support
- **rich_highlight_text_codespark** — Inline substring highlighting using Text.rich with custom styles
- **dual_tone_text_codespark** — Dual-tone gradient text rendering with vertical and horizontal color splits
- **curved_text_codespark** — Render text along circular, spiral, wave, elliptical, or custom paths
- **date_formatter_codespark** — DateTime extensions for formatting, relative time, time ago, and business day calculations
- **animated_dropdown_search_codespark** — Customisable animated search dropdown widget
- **read_more_codespark** — Expandable text widget for long-form content with customizable truncation
- **icon_to_text_extension_codespark** — Convert any IconData to inline Text or TextSpan with rich text builder

### Developer Utilities
- **advanced_text_input_formatters_codespark** — Extended input text formatter utilities for Flutter TextFields
- **internet_quality_codespark** — Measure real-world internet quality using latency-based analysis
- **context_extensions_codespark** — Build context utility extensions for cleaner widget code
